beats.text: Six things that quietly age your mind — long before your body.
One. Never learning anything new. An unused mind stiffens, exactly like an unused muscle.
Two. Only ever consuming, never creating. Making something keeps the mind limber.
Three. Avoiding all discomfort. Growth lives on the far side of a little difficulty.
Four. Same routine, same people, same thoughts, on a loop. Novelty is brain food.
Five. Scrolling instead of thinking. Endless input quietly crowds out your own ideas.
Six. Believing you're too old to change. That one belief ages you faster than any year.
A mind stays young as long as it keeps letting itself be surprised. Stay curious.
